name: MKX x Blazy Susan x 30 Liquid Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls | Candy Runtz
description: The Blazy Susan x MKX .5g Liquid Diamond Infused Pre-Roll 30-Pack delivers a powerful blend of full flavor and full effect in every hit. Crafted with precision and wrapped in ultra-thin Blazy Susan papers, each pre-roll offers a smooth, slow-burning experience for clean, consistent enjoyment. More than just a premium product, this 30-pack makes a difference — a portion of every purchase supports local Michigan Breast Cancer Awareness charities, helping fund education, early detection, and care for those affected. Every pack stands for quality, community, and compassion
